questions.question: What are the minimum deterministic authorization invariants that every Agent OS tool/action must satisfy regardless of model/provider?
questions.why: This is the safety boundary for all future autonomy.
questions.next_research: Threat-model current tools; compare minimal custom policy vs Cedar/OPA embedding.

questions.question: Which current Agent OS workflows have external side effects that are not exactly-once or idempotent across interruption/resume?
questions.why: Durable execution is unsafe if resumed work repeats side effects.
questions.next_research: Audit orchestrator, browser bridge, future email/calendar/finance actions.

questions.question: What real task corpus best represents the user's actual workload without exposing sensitive work/personal data to canonical Git or external providers?
questions.why: All routing and optimization quality depends on representative evaluation.
questions.next_research: Design local-private/synthetic/canonical split and sanitization policy.

questions.question: How should Agent OS estimate user effort and cognitive load, not merely task success/token cost?
questions.why: The end goal is reducing the user's burden, which current telemetry undermeasures.
questions.next_research: HCI metrics, interaction counts, correction burden, task resumption, interruption cost.

questions.question: What evidence threshold is sufficient to promote a candidate observation into a durable rule, skill, preference, or roadmap item?
questions.why: Too low causes memory/roadmap pollution; too high makes the system inert.
questions.next_research: Calibrate by object type and reversibility.

questions.question: How should contradictory memories/claims evolve over time without destructive overwrite?
questions.why: Personal/work reality changes and sources can disagree.
questions.next_research: Temporal bitemporal model, supersession, source reliability, conflict views.

questions.question: When does GraphRAG/knowledge-graph retrieval beat the existing hybrid/lexical approach enough to justify graph-maintenance cost?
questions.why: Graph systems are tempting but can duplicate indexes and create maintenance burden.
questions.next_research: Benchmark global synthesis vs entity/temporal queries on actual knowledge libraries.

questions.question: What is the smallest set of quality SLOs and budgets that actually predicts whether Agent OS is getting better for the user?
questions.why: Metric sprawl creates Goodhart pressure and operational overhead.
questions.next_research: Select 3-5 top-level outcome metrics plus diagnostic metrics.

questions.question: How can a proactive intervention's counterfactual value be estimated when the user never sees a suppressed suggestion?
questions.why: Precision is observable; missed opportunities are harder to measure.
questions.next_research: Sampled shadow review and retrospective opportunity audits.

questions.question: When should constructive challenge happen inline versus quietly as a candidate/digest item?
questions.why: Challenge is valuable but interruption has real cost.
questions.next_research: Task-boundary detection, urgency/reversibility thresholds, user feedback calibration.

questions.question: What threshold should trigger adoption of Temporal/Dapr rather than extending the existing lightweight workflow engine?
questions.why: Premature platform adoption may increase complexity; late adoption may waste work and reliability.
questions.next_research: Measure workflow duration, side effects, resume failures, event volume, experiment replay cost.

questions.question: How should model capability uncertainty be represented when eval samples are small or rapidly stale?
questions.why: Point estimates encourage brittle routing.
questions.next_research: Confidence intervals/Bayesian updates, minimum sample sizes, stale-evidence decay.

questions.question: How should judge disagreement be aggregated without turning multiple correlated model graders into fake certainty?
questions.why: LLM judges share training and bias; majority vote is not independent evidence.
questions.next_research: Deterministic rubrics, human calibration, judge diversity, position randomization, abstention.

questions.question: Which Agent OS state should be event-sourced versus stored only as current materialized state?
questions.why: Full event sourcing everywhere is likely unnecessary complexity.
questions.next_research: Classify audit-critical irreversible state, derived caches, and replaceable projections.

questions.question: How should research-radar cadence differ by ecosystem volatility and failure impact?
questions.why: Daily checks everywhere waste resources; slow checks may miss breaking deprecations.
questions.next_research: Risk-based cadence tiers and event-driven sources.

questions.question: Can component usage + capability overlap reliably identify safe deletions, or is human architectural review still required?
questions.why: A simplification engine could accidentally remove low-frequency but critical fallback paths.
questions.next_research: Shadow-disable experiments and fallback-criticality labels.

questions.question: How should future fine-tuning/distillation be isolated from personal/private evidence while still benefiting from repeated workflows?
questions.why: Training data can create irreversible leakage and hard-to-audit behavior.
questions.next_research: Synthetic/distilled sanitized traces, opt-in policy, local models, evaluation gates.

questions.question: How should Agent OS distinguish a genuinely new project from a recurring cross-project capability or a temporary task cluster?
questions.why: Over-projectization creates taxonomy churn.
questions.next_research: Evaluate project-candidate criteria against historical cases.

questions.question: What is the appropriate retention horizon for raw telemetry, traces, browser events, voice transcripts, and local learning evidence?
questions.why: More history helps learning but raises privacy/storage/security cost.
questions.next_research: Per-data-class value decay and retention policy.

questions.question: What would falsify the Meta-Improvement Engine itself—when should it be reduced, paused, or deleted?
questions.why: The optimizer must not become self-justifying bureaucracy.
questions.next_research: Define engine ROI metrics: accepted improvements, measured gains, research-to-change conversion, overhead, false-positive backlog.

unknown_unknown_domains: Causal inference for workflow changes when many variables change together
Safe online learning / contextual bandits for proactivity and routing
Formal methods/model checking for authorization and workflow invariants
Data contracts/schema evolution and automated migration correctness
Economics of information: deciding when additional research is worth its cost
Human memory/task-resumption research for personal executive support
Reversible computing/change-management patterns for agent-created artifacts
Adversarial ML against memory poisoning and long-horizon preference manipulation
Local-first synchronization/CRDT approaches for multi-device Agent OS state
Personal-data governance and lifecycle policy for ambient/lifelogging systems
